skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the theoretical foundations of natural resource economics, including concepts, types of natural resources, market supply and demand, optimal resource use, and sustainability.
Analyze natural resource policies and their impact on optimal and sustainable resource use.
Explain economic issues in the allocation and use of natural resources in a market economy.
Determine the economic value of natural resources and apply valuation methods.
Work effectively in groups to choose topics and solve problems in natural resource markets and products.
Present and defend analysis of natural resource issues in practical contexts.
Apply principles of natural resource analysis to specific situations and evaluate resource management policies.
